caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic mug positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The mug has a cylindrical shape with a pronounced round base and a curved handle attached to the right side. The surface of the mug is covered with a marbled brown and tan glaze, creating a mottled pattern of various brown shades on a lighter, beige base. The rim of the mug is slightly darker, and there are subtle highlights that suggest a glossy finish. Below the mug, faint handwriting is visible, reading “Salt Beegerrinss” and the abbreviated word “Oct” along with the number “18” in the lower right corner. There are no other objects or design elements in the composition.
title: Mug for Table Use
